# Getting help

1. **The [user guide](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/TiviBro/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.md)** explains every remote button, screen and setting, with a troubleshooting section.  The [wiki](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/TiviBro/wiki) has the same, one page per topic, plus installing and an FAQ.
2. **Something not working on the TV?**  Settings > Diagnostics > **Run connection test** checks each part in turn and says what failed.
3. **Still stuck?**  [Open an issue](https://github.com/ohmybahgosh/TiviBro/issues/new/choose) and pick the form that fits.  Never post logins, server addresses or stream links.

TiviBro is a player only: it doesn't provide channels, streams or playlists, so questions about a provider's content or account belong with the provider.
